title: Ordinary native direct evaluation respects horizontal coefficient maps
statement: Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite field extension, and $A_k=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{k+1}$ with the specified quotient maps [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Let $g:Z\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $P_g$ the ordinary native direct image on coefficient sequence-site modules [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Write $e_k^W$ for ordinary coefficient evaluation. Define $c_k:P_g;e_k^Y\cong e_k^Z;g_*^{A_k}$ by moduleEvalP followed by compactSupportDirectModel. For $n\le m$, $q:A_m\to A_n$, and every coefficient-system module $M$, the actual horizontal transitions [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition] obey $\tau^Y_{m,n,P_gM};\operatorname{Res}_q(c_{n,M});a_{q,e_n^ZM}=c_{m,M};g_*^{A_m}(\tau^Z_{m,n,M})$, where $a_q:g_*^{A_n};\operatorname{Res}_q\cong\operatorname{Res}_q;g_*^{A_m}$ is the identity-on-sections ordinary scalar comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. No cartesian-system condition, flatness, or properness is assumed.

proof.text: The left and right composite have the same horizontal section formula by the two half-calculations. Their heterogeneous equalities yield equality on every section. Extensionality of module-sheaf morphisms proves the ordinary square.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportOrdinaryDirectTransition {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (M : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Z) :
    (compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) g).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).map
        ((compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E g n).hom.app M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison g
        (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation.{u, u} l E Z n).obj M) =
    (compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E g m).hom.app M ≫
      (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage g
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).map
          ((compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E Z h).app M)
